title: Brianna C NDE 4224
content: My friend injected heroin into my left arm. He and his other friend were in a hurry to go to the store so they left me there in the apartment alone. I had immediately went for the kitchen to get a glass of water. I reached with my right hand to grab a glass from above the sink and I collapsed striking my chin on the counter. I fell to the floor. Immediately in my mind I was in the dark - I felt as if I was shot through space in a body fitted rocket. I remember saying to myself, 'What have I done? Is this how it's going to be forever? I want to go back to my body, PLEASE GOD LET ME GO BACK TO MY BODY.' I saw the out lining of my body in an orange glow far from me. I kept wondering if I was ever going to make it back to myself. It was very loud and shaky I felt so scared. It got worse and worse as I came back into my body. I wiggled my fingers and toes and then proceeded to move the rest of my body. I got up and made my way to the bathroom to see what was wrong with me because my head was pounding. I walked back to the kitchen and as I sat down the neighbor guy and the paramedics rushed in to me. The neighbor told me he thought I was dead because I had no heartbeat, nor was I breathing. My face was turning grey. He tried everything he could to revive me but it was no use so he called 911. I started to cry hysterically, thanking Jesus for a second chance over and over again. Thanks to him I'm still alive and here today at home with my family and I'm never putting another needle in my arm.
